title: Guardrail Metrics in Online A/B Testing: · Primary Metric (North Star) · Secondary Diagnostic Metrics
prompt: **Guardrail Metrics in Online A/B Testing:** You are running an A/B test for a new ML ranking model. Define your **Primary Metric (North Star)**, **Secondary Diagnostic Metrics**, and **Invariant/Guardrail Metrics** (e.g., P99 latency, crash rate, ad load, creator diversity). Under what condition do you kill an experiment even if the Primary Metric is significantly positive?
